item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents
item.description: AI coding agents operate without persistent memory; useful outputs produced in one session are unavailable in the next, and information from one project never transfers to another. We present DevMemory, a structured memory management architecture that brings trust-scored, cross-scope knowledge retrieval to AI coding agents. item.title: Civilization Engineering A Generative Architecture for Building Civilizations through Text, Models, Knowledge, Institutions, Memory, and Intergenerational Handoff
item.description: Description Civilization Engineering develops a systematic framework for studying how civilizations can be intentionally shaped, tested, preserved, revised, and transmitted across generations. The central proposition is that civilizations are not produced only by governments, technologies, economies, or historical accidents. They are also generated through interacting systems of values, language, narratives, models, protocols, institutions, practices, memory, and inheritance. Civilization Engine

item.title: Open Agent Collaboration Gateway (OACG)
item.description: Open Agent Collaboration Gateway (OACG) v0.1.0 The first public release of OACG, an open-source reference implementation for bounded, auditable collaboration between heterogeneous AI systems. This release begins with OpenAI and xAI/Grok and establishes a provider-independent architecture intended to expand to Claude and additional AI systems. Included in v0.1.0 OpenAI and Grok provider adapters Bounded multi-model collaboration /ask and /collaborate APIs Human approval gates for higher-risk work

item.title: Simulation code for "Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum"
item.description: R + targets pipeline reproducing the experiments in the arXiv preprint arXiv:2603.05614, "Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum": the topology x load ablation grid, the DSIC strategic-bidding test, a measured agentic LLM workload, and the integrator faithfulness and encapsulation-overhead studies. item.title: Optimalisatie van de block-and-lock strategie voor een HIV genezing: Het combineren van BRD4 modulatoren met LEDGINs
item.description: Infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) is currently incurable because the virus integrates into the host genome of long-lived memory CD4+ T cells and can persist in a transcriptionally silent state, known as latency. Antiretroviral therapy (ART) effectively suppresses viral replication, restores CD4+ T cell counts, and prevents disease progression, transforming HIV-1 infection from a death sentence to a manageable chronic disease.
